description: This file defines the NotificationNavbarDisplayDriver class, which manages the display of user notifications in the navigation bar within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles authorization, retrieves unread notifications for the current user, and manages caching policies.

classes.name: NotificationNavbarDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver responsible for rendering the notification navigation bar for the current user, including fetching unread notifications and handling caching.

methods.name: NotificationNavbarDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor that injects dependencies such as authorization, HTTP context accessor, notification options, and database session.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the display result for the notification navbar, including authorization check, data retrieval, and cache configuration.
